errors.text_span: Оста X във всички три диаграми е обозначена като „време"
errors.evidence: The x-axis is not labeled with text; it shows numeric tick marks from about 0 to 1000. There is no visible label reading "време".
The y-axis is not labeled with text; only numeric tick marks are visible. There is no visible label reading "стойност".

Each subplot contains two lines, but saying there are three line charts and then describing the lines as if there is a single shared set of lines can be misleading given the figure has three separate subplots.

errors.text_span: В първата диаграма (ρ = 0.25) стойностите са в диапазон от -30 до +10.
errors.evidence: In the first subplot, the y-axis tick labels extend roughly from -30 to 10, but the plotted lines exceed +10 and reach above +15, so this stated range is not fully accurate for the data.

errors.text_span: Във втората диаграма (ρ = 0.5) стойностите са в диапазон от -10 до +40.
errors.evidence: In the second subplot, the y-axis extends roughly from -10 to 50, not to +40. The top visible tick is about 50.

errors.text_span: В третата диаграма (ρ = 0.75) стойностите са в диапазон от -20 до +30.
errors.evidence: In the third subplot, the y-axis extends roughly from -20 to 30, but the blue and orange lines dip below -20 slightly and the plotted range is centered around ticks from -20 to 30 with visible values near -20 to +30; the statement is broadly close but not exact.

errors.text_span: Двете линии са със същия стил – плътна линия с кръгли маркери.
errors.evidence: The lines are solid and colored blue/orange, but there are no visible circular markers on any of the lines.
